name: Oregon Senate Bill 1546 — Relating to Artificial Intelligence Companion Chatbots
description: Oregon statute regulating AI companion chatbots: mandates clear and recurring disclosure that the chatbot is artificially generated and not human, prohibits misrepresentation as a licensed health care provider, requires suicidal-ideation/self-harm crisis intervention and referral protocols, imposes heightened minor-safety protections, and provides both Attorney General enforcement and a private right of action.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by State of Oregon (oregon.gov) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within State of Oregon (oregon.gov).
